fusions.name: Lengthwise Bolt
fusions.desc: You gather power down the length of the staff and loose it as a bolt at the first enemy within 12 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Sparking Ferrule
fusions.desc: You rap the butt of the staff on the ground and sparks fly in a ring, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 15% chance to leave each [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Up the Wood
fusions.desc: You plant the staff and draw raw power up through it, restoring 4 mana a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Overspill
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, a spark leaps from the head of the staff to the nearest enemy within 9 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
